title_zh: 点一份调味清淡的鱼配米饭

scenario.goal_zh: 核对酱汁、配菜和调味需求后完成点餐

context_zh: 顾客询问比奶油意面清淡的选项，并确认配菜和调味。
author: author-phase04-a

sentences.speaker: Isaac
sentences.text: Is there a lighter option than the pasta with cream sauce?

sentences.speaker: Server
sentences.text: We have grilled fish with rice and vegetables.

sentences.speaker: Isaac
sentences.text: That sounds good. Could I have lemon on the side instead of a sauce?

sentences.speaker: Server
sentences.text: Certainly. Would you like a little olive oil over the vegetables?

sentences.speaker: Isaac
sentences.text: Yes, just a little. I will have the fish with rice and vegetables, please.

sentences.speaker: Server
sentences.text: Of course. Lemon on the side and a little oil on the vegetables.
